calculation: CSS Grid fit-content() uses max(auto minimum, min(limit, max-content)). For columns, Ahem text has 20px min-content and 110px max-content widths: limits 10px, 40px, and 120px yield 20px, 40px, and 110px. A two-track fixed repeat yields [40px,40px]. The fixed named-area matrix keeps its authored 20px first track and sizes the area-backed fit track at 40px. At 20px inline size the text wraps to four 10px lines; fit-content(20px) floors the row at its 40px minimum contribution.
limits: Chrome oracle only; not Spinon runtime, a simulator surface, or WPT conformance.
Covers finite non-negative pixel arguments on explicit columns and one row, plus fixed integer repeat expansion.
Does not cover percentage or calc arguments, auto tracks, line names, auto-repeat, area-created unsized tracks, or implicit tracks.
